newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FIVE BELGIAN YOUNGSTERS DIE AS TRAIN HITS CAR.
newsitem.headline: FIVE BELGIAN YOUNGSTERS DIE AS TRAIN HITS CAR.

text.p: Five Belgians died on Monday when a rush-hour train crushed their car at a railway crossing on the line between the port of Antwerp and the city of Liege in the east, a spokeswoman for state railways said.
The identity of the three men and two women and their exact ages were not yet known. "They were all young," she said. No one on the train was hurt. The cause of the crash was still unclear.
Rescue crews struggled to separate the car and the train in order to clear the line.

As a result of the accident, which happened at 8.50 a.m. (0650 GMT) just east of Antwerp, rail traffic between the two towns was blocked all morning, the spokeswoman said, but international trains were not affected.
